_comment: SYNTHETIC taxonomy (enlarged to clear Haiku's ~4096-token cache minimum). Generic narrative categories only — no real product taxonomy, prompts, or business logic.

categories.description: The first beat whose only job is to arrest attention before the viewer scrolls away.
